The basics

What is an AI employee?

An AI employee is an AI agent trained to do one job in your business, the way a new hire would. It learns your services, prices and policies, works on the channels your customers already use, and follows the rules you set.

Unlike a new hire, it starts in days, works 24/7, answers in seconds and never forgets to follow up. And when a customer needs a person, it hands over to your team with the full conversation.

  • Answers every enquiry in seconds, day and night
  • Qualifies leads and books appointments
  • Works on website, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and phone
  • Speaks English, Arabic, Spanish and 100+ languages
  • Connects to your CRM and calendar
  • Built, trained and managed by our team

FAQ

AI employees, explained.

What is an AI employee?

An AI employee is an AI agent trained to do one job in your business, such as answering enquiries, qualifying leads, booking appointments or making follow-up calls. It works on your real channels (website, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, phone), follows your rules and hands over to your team when a person is needed.

How much does an AI employee cost?

DigiPromise AI employees start from $685 (AED 2,500) a month, plus a one-time setup fee from $1,365 (AED 5,000). Pay annually and you save 15%, with the setup fee fully waived on Starter and 50% off on other plans. See the pricing page for every plan.

Will an AI employee replace my staff?

It replaces the repetitive part of the job, not your team. Your AI employee answers the same questions, chases the same leads and books the same appointments around the clock, so your people spend their time on customers who are ready to buy.

Do you work with businesses in the United States?

Yes. We work with businesses in the US, the UAE and worldwide. US clients are billed in USD, and your AI employee works in your time zone, 24/7.

What languages can an AI employee speak?

English, Arabic, Spanish, Russian and 100+ other languages. It replies in the language your customer writes in.

Do I need technical skills?

No. Our team builds, trains, connects and manages your AI employee. You approve the scope and see every conversation and lead in your dashboard.

How is an AI employee different from a chatbot?

A basic chatbot follows fixed buttons and scripts. An AI employee understands free-text questions, is trained on your services, prices and policies, takes actions such as booking and lead capture, and connects to your CRM.
